_comment: LoopStar GENERATIVE material pack for Alt-R&B (2026-08-09). Companion sound pack + phrases/altrnb/. RULE #1: content, zero rebuild.
name: Alt-R&B
blurb: Modern alt-R&B: an unhurried cross-stick pocket, lush Rhodes 9ths and 11ths with lots of space, and a deep sliding sub bass.

flavors.label: Slow Jam
flavors.blurb: Two lush maj9 chords held two bars each, cross-stick pocket, acres of space.

flavors.label: Gospel Turn
flavors.blurb: Churchier: I-vi-ii-V with a 13sus dominant and real movement under the vocal.

flavors.label: Night Drive
flavors.blurb: Darker minor loop, i-bVI-bVII, keys pushed forward against a sliding sub.

flavors.label: One Chord Float
flavors.blurb: A single m11 that never moves; the drums and the silence carry the whole loop.

flavors.label: Half Time Knock
flavors.blurb: Trap-leaning: muted Rhodes stabs on a tight grid over a Dorian two-chord vamp.

arranger.llmStyleBrief: Alt-R&B harmony is slow, lush and unresolved: m7, m9, m11 and maj9 held two bars each at 72-96bpm. Prefer Dorian i-IV vamps, the i-bVI-bVII loop, and gospel I-vi-ii-V turnarounds. Never write a plain triad or a plain V7 -- voice the dominant as sus4 or swap it for bVII7. Leave space.
